question: Should bundled dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets proceed now, and what log-stream, redaction, scope, retention, export, and command-output boundaries must they use?
rationale: The request is plausible but exposes operational logs and command output in a new dashboard surface while depending on unresolved dashboard substrate and binding-security decisions.

options.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
options.body: Keep this issue open, settle Wave 1 dashboard and stream/log-output contracts first, then implement widgets against approved read-only contracts.

options.title: Narrow To Existing Read-Only Data
options.body: Permit a focused widget PR that consumes only existing logs.tail and already-recorded output snapshots, excluding new command execution or generic command bindings.

options.title: Defer Bundled Builtins
options.body: Keep this as roadmap context and ask contributors to focus on external plugins or missing plugin APIs until maintainers sponsor bundled dashboard widgets.

recommendation.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, settle Wave 1 dashboard and stream/log-output contracts first, then implement widgets against approved read-only contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest merged-code routing signal is the existing Logs tab/log-tail and native Control UI plugin-tab precedent.
